rec.fixedFeatureUpdate: NVD names the fix for {{branch}} ({{fixed}}), not for the Windows release {{device}} runs ({{version}}): Microsoft no longer updates that release, so no monthly update brings it this fix. Move {{device}} to a Windows release Microsoft still services (a feature update). If Windows Update still offers it monthly updates, install the latest and check Microsoft's advisory.
rec.fixedEsu: Fixed in {{fixed}}, an Extended Security Update: Microsoft updates {{branch}} past the end of its support only for devices enrolled in Extended Security Updates. If {{device}} (now {{version}}) is enrolled, install it; otherwise move {{device}} to a Windows release Microsoft still services.
rec.fixedEndListed: {{device}} runs {{version}}, inside the range NVD lists as "before {{fixed}}". {{fixed}} is not the fix: NVD lists {{fixed}} itself, or releases of it, as affected too, and names no fixed release for {{version}}. The vendor advisory lists the releases that fix it; if none is one {{device}} can run, protect it another way (What CISA requires) or plan to replace it.
rec.fixedUpTo: Versions up to {{fixed}} are affected, and {{device}} runs {{version}}: upgrade to a release after {{fixed}}. The version data does not name it; the vendor advisory does.
rec.fixedBranches: {{device}} has no version yet, so Vedette lists the fix of each release line: {{list}}. Add the version to see the one for this device.

rec.fixedDistroAny: {{device}} runs {{product}} {{version}} from its distribution's packages, in the affected range: install the distribution's security updates for it (for example apt upgrade or dnf upgrade) and check its notice for this CVE.
rec.fixedDistroBelow: {{distro}} backports fixes, so the package's version number may stay below {{fixed}}, the upstream release that fixes it.
rec.fixedDistroBelowAny: The distribution backports fixes, so the package's version number may stay below {{fixed}}, the upstream release that fixes it.
rec.fixedIfDistro: If you installed {{product}} from {{distro}}'s packages, install its security updates instead (for example apt upgrade): {{distro}} backports the fix under its own version number, so the number above may never appear.

rec.step3: Then press "I updated it" at the top of this page and type the new version: Vedette checks it and closes every finding on {{device}} that version fixes. For software a scan reads, run a scan of {{device}} instead.
rec.step3Manual: Then press "I updated {{software}}" at the top of this page and type the new version: Vedette checks it and closes every finding on {{device}} that version fixes.
rec.step3Agent: The agent reports the new version by itself, usually within two hours (after the restart the update needs). Vedette then closes the findings on {{device}} it can prove that version fixes; if this one stays open, press "Mark as handled" and choose Patched.
rec.step3AgentGone: No agent reports {{device}} to Vedette now, so the new version does not arrive by itself: install its agent again so it reports the new one. Vedette then closes the findings on {{device}} it can prove that version fixes; if this one stays open, press "Mark as handled" and choose Patched.
rec.step3Snmp: Then press "Read with SNMP now" on the page of {{device}}: Vedette reads the new version (it also does in each scan window) and closes the findings on {{device}} it can prove that version fixes. If this one stays open, press "Mark as handled" and choose Patched.
rec.step3Stated: {{device}} states its new version on the network by itself after the update, and Vedette then closes the findings on {{device}} it can prove that version fixes. If this one stays open, press "Mark as handled" and choose Patched.
rec.step3Scan: Then rescan {{device}} with the button under Evidence: the scan reads the new version and Vedette closes the findings on {{device}} it can prove that version fixes. If this one stays open, press "Mark as handled" and choose Patched.
rec.step3Mark: Then press "Mark as handled" at the top of this page and choose Patched. If the version was already fixed, choose False positive and write the version in the note.

todo.fixUpdateNoVersion: Fixed in {{fixed}}: update {{product}} on {{device}} to {{fixed}} or later.
todo.fixDistro: Fixed in the distribution's package {{fixed}}: install the security updates of {{device}} (for example apt upgrade or dnf upgrade). It has {{version}}.
todo.fixDistroNoVersion: Fixed in the distribution's package {{fixed}}: install the security updates of {{device}} (for example apt upgrade or dnf upgrade).
todo.fixDistroPro: Fixed in the package {{fixed}}, which only Ubuntu Pro (ESM) has. Ubuntu Pro is free for personal use on a few machines: attach it on {{device}} (sudo pro attach), then install the updates. Without Ubuntu Pro, accept the risk or remove the package.
todo.fixOsEsu: {{line}} This build comes only with Extended Security Updates: without an ESU subscription, move to a release Microsoft still updates.
todo.fixOs: Fixed in build {{fixed}}: install the latest monthly update on {{device}}.
todo.fixOsKb: Fixed in build {{fixed}} ({{kb}}): install the latest monthly update on {{device}}.
todo.fixFeature: No update of the release {{device}} runs fixes it: move it to {{fixed}}, a release that has the fix.
todo.fixNoneYet: The vendor has no fixed release of {{product}} for this yet: follow the vendor advisory, and use the steps below until one ships.
todo.fixNoneYetDistro: No fixed package of {{product}} yet: watch for the distribution's update or accept the risk.
todo.fixSource: The same release the findings list and the plan name. Check the vendor advisory before you update.
todo.noWorkaround: No workaround is published: install the fix.
todo.fwNoPack: No firewall configuration is published for {{cve}}: Vedette maintainers have not confirmed one, and Vedette does not write one by guesswork.
todo.fwAsk: Your AI writes a configuration for {{firewall}} from this device's open ports. Read every line before you paste it.
todo.fwAskAny: Your AI writes a configuration from this device's open ports. Read every line before you paste it.
todo.checkVersionAdvisory: {{software}} on {{device}} shows the fixed release the vendor advisory names.
todo.checkRestart: If the update asks for a restart, restart {{device}}: the old version keeps running until then.
todo.checkWorkaround: If you put the workaround in place, undo it once the new version shows, where it gets in your users' way.
todo.fixPlan: The plan updates {{product}} on {{device}} to {{target}}, a later release that also fixes this CVE.
todo.fixAdvisory: Check the vendor advisory before you update.
todo.fixRestart: The fixed {{product}} {{fixed}} is already installed on {{device}}: restart {{device}} so it runs it.
todo.restartNoWorkaround: No workaround is needed: the fix is installed and takes effect when {{device}} restarts.
todo.checkRestartNow: Restart {{device}}: it runs the old {{product}} until then.
